REM From FunnelScript is a Go CLI, local web app, and MCP server for investigating how companies acquire customers from public evidence.

- Research a domain, App Store listing or Google Play listing.
- Inspect citations, download Markdown and JSON, and compare saved runs.
- Run the recorded Cal AI example locally with `rem demo`.
- Configure Scrape Creators for paid and social collection, or a supported writer for a strategy draft.

Download the archive for your operating system and CPU. Compare its SHA-256 hash with the published `SHA256SUMS`. The macOS binaries are unsigned. Building from source with `go install github.com/funnelscript/rem-from-funnelscript/cmd/rem@v0.1.0` is also supported.

The keyless workflow was verified live on macOS. Optional paid sources and authenticated report writers have fixture coverage. See the README and verification ledger for details.
